text:
kai: Planning a 'reverse-canary' FF flip for routing.region-priority during low traffic Tues 2026-08-10 01:00-03:00 UTC. Idea: roll EU -> US -> APAC so we can catch region-specific regressions early. Need thumbs and the pin/rollback plan.

meera: Love reverse-canary for region-specific infra. Proposed ramp per region: EU 1% (8m) -> 8% (12m) -> 30% (25m). Then US same, then APAC same. Holdpoint at each step.

raj: SLO gates: errors (5xx + model-timeouts) > 0.55% OR p95 > 340ms for 2 consecutive 5m buckets => hold. Add a token-inflation metric: if avg tokens/sec per request jumps >20% hold (we saw this cause cascades).

kai: Important: session-affinity preservation on pin. If we pin a cohort we must route their sticky sessions back to previous version to avoid user-visible regressions. Include cohort and session_prefix in logs.

oncall-ops: I'll cover the window. I'll set the alerts to require 2 consecutive 5m buckets for the SLOs and add the tokens/sec alert. If hold occurs, auto-pin cohort + sticky sessions, open incident bridge, and post status.

deploy-bot: Scheduling job: 2026-08-10T01:00Z/2026-08-10T03:00Z. Reverse-canary routing plan queued. Auto-pin and session-affinity rollback configured. Manual resume required after any pause >20m.

Runbook snippet for ops (paste to playbook):

```
deploybot schedule --service inference-api \
  --window "2026-08-10T01:00Z/2026-08-10T03:00Z" \
  --ff routing.region-priority \
  --ramp "EU:1:8m,8:12m,30:25m;US:1:8m,8:12m,30:25m;APAC:1:8m,8:12m,30:25m" \
  --holds "errors>0.55% OR p95>340ms OR tokens_per_sec_inflation>20%" \
  --hold-agg "2x5m" --on-breach pin=previous --pin-scope "cohort,session_prefix" \
  --fallback route=model-quant-v2 --meta rollout_tag=revcanary-0810 --meta changelog_id=CL-4872
```

meera: Add quality gate: sample 0.5% outputs and run quick-eval; if quality delta > 3.5% hold. Also emit `rollout_tag=revcanary-0810` on traces.

raj: If token-inflation triggers, prefer throttle + small backoff (reduce ramp rate) before full pin if errors are stable; use manual checklist to decide. Documented in runbook.

oncall-ops: I'll attach alert screenshots and a smoke-test script before EOD Monday. I'll also enable extra trace sampling for EU during its window.

kai: Release notes (internal short): "Reverse-canary region-first rollout for routing.region-priority with SLO and token-inflation gates. Session-affinity pinning and model-quant fallback enabled. Oncall monitoring active." We'll post minimal public blurb after successful completion.

meera: Approvals? :eyes:

raj: Approved.

oncall-ops: Approved, I'll be oncall.

deploy-bot: Rollout APPROVED and scheduled. Notifications will post to #eng-releases and #eng-sre at T-30m and at start. Reminder: any automated pin logs cohort_id and session_prefix to aid rollback tracing.
